name: Tata Communications Ltd.
business_summary: Global enterprise network and digital-services company (ex-VSNL), 58.85% held by Tata group (Panatone Finvest 44.8%, Tata Sons 14.07%). Core connectivity (MPLS, SD-WAN, internet, subsea/ IZO), media and entertainment, and a growing digital portfolio (cloud, CPaaS/Kaleyra, IoT, security, collaboration). TTM revenue ~Rs26.0k cr (Q2 FY27 Rs6,688 cr, +9.6% y/y), EBITDA ~Rs5.2k cr (21.3% margin in Q2, record), PAT Rs336-341 cr in Q2 (+86%). Announced a $450m 'AI Super Highway' build (2026-10-26).

revenue_mix.segment: digital platform (cloud, CPaaS, IoT, security, collaboration, media)
revenue_mix.geography: global; digital platform revenue +18.6% y/y in Q2

cost_structure.input: network and bandwidth costs (access, backhaul, license)

exposures.mechanism: AI Super Highway ($450m, targets up to 40% share of AI-network demand) and GPU/cloud (Vayu) benefit from AI data-centre interconnect demand. AI/data-centre-linked connectivity and cloud ~10% of revenue (~Rs2.6k cr, estimate); +10% AI capex growth => +10% on that base = +Rs260 cr at ~45% incremental margin = +Rs117 cr = +2.3% EBITDA; x EV/MCap 1.23 x persistence 1.0 (structural) = +2.5. Low-medium confidence: capex ($450m ~Rs3.8k cr) is ~75% of annual EBITDA, so returns risk is real.
